title: Use borders to distinguish cargo label status
goal: Use dotted lines to mark the labels of goods to be counted, and keep the solid lines of the labels of goods that have been counted.
summary: border-style determines the line style of the border. solid is a solid line and dashed is a dashed line. The default value none causes the border to not be displayed.
tasks: Only set border-style: dashed for cargo labels with pending class.
retains the solid line of the counted cargo tag and uses the green 2px border setting of the two cargo tags.

example.note: map can be drawn as a circle of dotted lines using dotted.

hint: The border width and color of the cargo label have been set. If the border is still invisible, check to see if the pending border-style is set to dashed.
